items: Your creatures' sigils are pink, light purple, light blue and turquoise; the wild ones' crimson, red, orange and yellow; bigger the older they are
Each rune stone shows its area's creatures as a column of sigils, friends above the still-wild
Music notes on the ground south of a stone show where to cast; a rainbow ring round the stone fills as you cast
When an area turns, its stone flares and the sigils of its new friends drop down to their feet
Leashes are chains, their links bigger the older the creature
